item.tib: gsang sngags yid bzhin nor bu'i gsang sgrub bcud gril
item.coloph: mthar thugs gnad kyi bcud dril 'di/ bla ma stong rgyung bdag la gnang*/ bdag gi sems bskyed rnam dag gis/ yi ge bkod pa'i dge ba 'dis/ 'gro rnams lam 'bras bsgrod pa'i phyir/ dar rgyas 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog bdag 'dra drung mu ha ra la/ tsong sgom dad pas zhus ngor byin//
